identity: A Modern Standard Arabic popular-science / cultural essay (maqal) titled خيالهم وخيالنا. It argues that imagination is constitutive of human consciousness, narrates the birth of experimental science from Galileo watching a cathedral chandelier in 1581, tracks the steam engine and telegraph, and then traces the emergence and maturation of science fiction (Verne, Wells, Orwell, Huxley, Asimov) up to its 1960s slump and recovery. Register is expository-argumentative with a visible authorial voice (ونستطيع بذلك أن نقول، كما سنبين لاحقا، وإني لأرى) and literary metaphor (نهر العلم، صحاري الخيال المجهولة). Two section headings are preserved as their own one-line paragraphs: وبعث العلم (113-114) and خيال جديد (372-373); the first line خيالهم وخيالنا (0-1) is the title. The prose carries heavy inline citation apparatus - Latin-script names plus Arabic-numeral birth/death pairs plus م - which inflates token counts without adding clauses, so token length alone is a poor proxy for sentence length here.
law: The sentence unit is the terminated proposition of essay prose, here roughly 18-40 tokens once citation apparatus is discounted. The token immediately before every <NL> and the final token always close a sentence and are given; an <NL> never carries one. Inside a paragraph a boundary falls only where a NEW predication begins that the preceding clause does not govern. The signals that license one: (a) an asyndetic clause with a fresh explicit subject - the strongest signal in this text; (b) و + a fronted adverbial that resets the frame (ومنذ وجوده على الأرض، وعلى الرغم من، وفي عام ١٥٨٩) or و + إنّ with lam al-ibtidaa (وإني لأرى); (c) و + perfect verb carrying a genuine topic shift with a new subject (ومضى النهر، وبدأت المحاولات، وانتشرت تلك القصص); (d) و + existential هناك opening a fresh assertion; (e) a meta-discursive or imperative move by the author (ونستطيع بذلك أن نقول، وقس على ذلك). The signals that do NOT license one: coordinating و joining nouns, or joining verbs that share a subject and topic (وتعددت، وأصبح، والقاطرات، وألدوس); the subordinators and linkers ثم، حتى، بل، كما، مع أن، الذي، إلا أن، لدرجة أن، ليستخدم؛ and above all the explanatory or consecutive فـ, which in this author is comma-level and always justifies the clause it directly follows (فهو لا يكتفي، فمضى يتخيل، فوجدت آلهة، فخيالنا، فقد استرعت، فقد بدأ، فقد أثبت، فجاء المحرك، فقد تحققت، فتقنيات، فانطلقت العقول). One exception is admitted to the فـ rule: فـ + a fresh nominal subject that opens an extended development the previous sentence cannot govern, as at فالبعض يرجع الخيال العلمي (451). Headings and the title are each one sentence.
reasoning: GIVEN: 1 وخيالنا، 86 الحيوانات، 111 لاحقا، 114 العلم، 147 حينها، 192 تاريخها، 253 السنة، 335 برقية، 370 بنفسه، 373 جديد، 397 والقصير، 510 العلمي، 554 الإيرادات، 642 المستقبلي، 742 المجهولة - fifteen paragraph-final or doc-final positions, taken as fixed. Fourteen internal calls follow. (36 الحدث, hi) - ومنذ وجوده على الأرض fronts a temporal PP and restarts with كان; the preceding بل يبحث دوما... عن علل الظواهر وما وراء الحدث is complete. (15 الأرضية, REJECTED) - فهو لا يكتفي is the explanatory فـ elaborating the definitional claim about الوعي; comma-level by my law, and rejecting it here keeps me consistent with rejecting 79 فخيالنا and 703 فتقنيات, which are the same shape. (66 تفسيره, med) - ونستطيع بذلك أن نقول إن is a conclusion-drawing meta-move; بذلك is summative and such moves open sentences. (130 وسكونه, hi) - the single clearest internal site in the document: ينظر إليها فتانا ذو السبعة عشر عاما is asyndetic, with a brand-new explicit subject, after a complete clause about the chandelier. No connective at all in unpunctuated Arabic after a finished predication is near-proof of a period. (154 م, REJECTED) - كان ذلك في عام ١٥٨١ م / وكان فتانا هو جاليليو is و joining two identical كان-frames about the same moment; paradigm intra-sentential coordination. (164 م, hi) - وعلى الرغم من ملايين الثريات... إلا أن is a fronted concessive with its own apodosis, a self-contained new sentence. (181 المرة, REJECTED) - فقد استرعت gives the reason ثريتنا is exceptional; explanatory فـ. (201 تماما, REJECTED) - بدأ العلم من تلك النقطة مسارا جديدا تماما is a thesis line and فقد بدأ الفتى is its evidence; tempting as a period but it is the same فقد shape as 181, 263 and 688, and I refuse to split the class. (229 تجاربه, hi) - وفي عام ١٥٨٩ م أنهى دراسته: و + fronted date PP + perfect verb, after the Galileo-mechanics narrative closes. (236 الجامعية, REJECTED) - وفي نفس العام is anaphoric to that very date and packages the two events together; the parallel surface form is not enough to override the tight backward link. (245 الجسم, med) - والبعض يؤرخ shifts to a new subject, to the present tense, and to authorial commentary about periodisation rather than narrative. (272 الإنسان, med) - ومضى النهر يسقي resumes the river metaphor as a new movement after فقد أثبت فاعلية عظيمة has closed its justification. (278 العطشى, REJECTED) - فجاء المحرك البخاري is consecutive فـ. (308 م, hi) - وبدأت المحاولات لإرسال التلغرافات هي الأخرى: new subject, new technology, and هي الأخرى explicitly marks it as a second strand. (436 م, REJECTED) - مع أنه من المجحف is a trailing concessive subordinate to the Verne/Wells clause; it cannot close it. (450 قبلهم, med) - the admitted فـ exception. Holding 399-497 together would make one 99-token sentence, and فالبعض يرجع opens a 47-token excursus on the Thousand and One Nights that the Verne/Wells sentence in no way governs. (460 ويلز, REJECTED) - منها مثلا بعض قصص ألف ليلة وليلة parses as a complete nominal sentence, but it reads as an appositive listing hung on مؤلفات، and خصوصا قصة الفرس continues that same list. (486 الطيران, REJECTED) - وهو مزود بأزرار ولوالب is a haal clause still describing الفرس الميكانيكي, as is ويطير بأن يمتلئ جوفه. (497 بالهواء, med) - وهناك أوصاف علمية أخرى is و + existential opening a fresh assertion that closes the paragraph. (528 الكتاب, lo) - a true coin-flip. Syntactically وانتشرت is indistinguishable from the وتعددت / وأصبح chain before it, which I keep intra-sentential; I break here only because the topic shifts from the genre maturing to the genre spreading commercially, and because my law already licenses و + verb + new subject + topic shift at 272 and 308. Marked lo because the sole warrant is discourse, not syntax. (596 رائع, REJECTED) - وكما في تلك الروايات is the second limb of the كما فعل جورج أرويل comparison. (623 الفلسفة, hi) - وقس على ذلك switches to the imperative with a summative على ذلك; a directive to the reader always opens a sentence. (662 الأمريكية, hi) - وإني لأرى أن: و + inna + lam al-ibtidaa is an unambiguous sentence opener in MSA and marks the turn from report to authorial opinion. (687 كتابه, REJECTED) and (703 شيء, REJECTED) - فقد تحققت نبوءات and فتقنيات الخيال العلمي بدت are both explanatory فـ, each justifying the clause immediately before it; rejecting 703 is what keeps 15 and 79 defensible. (719 حياتهم, lo) - the other coin-flip, and the hardest. إلى أن تعافى مجددا attaches semantically all the way back to عانى الخيال العلمي... من انحسارات at the head of the paragraph, across a long opinion digression; the subject of تعافى is الخيال العلمي, not تقنيات. Starting a sentence with إلى أن is stylistically loose, but the alternative is a single 80-token sentence from 663 to 742, which this author never otherwise writes. I break before it and mark it lo. Result: 29 sentences over 743 tokens, mean about 26 tokens, consistent with the essay register once name-and-date apparatus is discounted.
